dialogues.speaker: Minoo
dialogues.text: Like the "Brave Aranara." They might be small, but very brave.

dialogues.speaker: Minoo
dialogues.text: Despite their fear of fire, Aranara would protect the forest... *sob* Putting out wildfires with their bodies...

dialogues.speaker: Minoo
dialogues.text: Wait, no, that's just a childhood story! Minoo is older now and doesn't believe in that anymore...
